purpose: Assets originais de apresentação; textos, retratos, valores e ações separados da arte.

prompts.rent:
Use case: ui-mockup / game UI asset. Generate ONE ORIGINAL production-ready isolated blank rent-price plaque for the Brazilian cartoon 3D board game Império Urbano. Genuine transparent background, no scene, no board, no text, no letters, no numerals, no currency symbol, no icons.
A very slim horizontal rounded rectangular miniature plaque, premium polished beveled brass/gold frame, dark midnight-indigo enamel flat central writing surface, two tiny tasteful brass rivets at left and right ends, restrained amber reflections, tiny self-contained bevel shading. Orthographic front view, axis-aligned, neutral upper-left lighting, perfectly symmetrical geometry and clean antialiased edges. The center is completely EMPTY, dark and quiet, suitable for overlaying dynamic white price text later. Small-game-scale readability is essential: not ornate, not a giant thick frame, no embossed decoration in the writing area. Match a premium cheerful detailed cartoon 3D tabletop aesthetic, warm gold edge and indigo material. Shape aspect ratio about 5:1. Wide landscape canvas about 1536×384, tightly framed with only a small transparent safety margin; the plaque occupies almost all width and most height. Do not produce a contact sheet or variations. Single reusable blank asset only.
prompts.player:
Use case: game UI asset. Create ONE original reusable BLANK PLAYER NAMEPLATE FRAME for the premium cartoon 3D Brazilian tabletop game Império Urbano. Genuine transparent background. Single object, no grid, no scene.
Warm polished brass/gold beveled horizontal plinth with dark midnight-indigo enamel writing face, at its LEFT end a large round raised gold portrait bezel joined smoothly to the horizontal plaque. The circular portrait socket is EMPTY dark indigo; no portrait, no person, no silhouette. The right writing surface is completely empty and spacious, for later dynamic player name and balance in HTML. No text, no letters, no numbers, no symbols, no badges or crown. Fine warm reflections and convincing compact contact/bevel shading intrinsic to the object. Orthographic front view, straight and axis aligned, no slanted perspective. Tasteful cheerful detailed cartoon 3D game object, rounded corners, not ornate filigree. Overall aspect ratio about 3.2:1, round portrait bezel occupies the left quarter. High-resolution wide canvas, object fills almost the whole image with minimal transparent margin, no large empty borders. Match gold/indigo rent plaque style, polished bright brass edges and quiet deep indigo center.
prompts.dock:
Use case: game UI asset. ONE original blank ACTION DOCK / CONTROL BASE for a premium cheerful cartoon 3D Brazilian tabletop game, matching warm polished gold/brass and midnight-indigo enamel materials. True transparent background.
A low, very wide horizontal tray-like game control plinth with generously rounded ends, a substantial but tasteful beveled gold rim, tiny warm underside thickness, flat EMPTY midnight-indigo enamel top face. Very slight raised central crest along the upper edge, but no labeled round badge. Entire face is flat, uncluttered and blank, ready for separate live controls to be overlaid later: player identity at left, two dice in middle, timer and button at right. DO NOT draw any player, dice, button, icon, clock, text, numeral, socket dividers, partitions, logos, or ornament. No website, scene, board or background. Orthographic frontal presentation with slight visible front thickness, clean axis-aligned shape, balanced upper-left lighting, crisp high-quality game asset. Width about 5 times height, fill image with minimal transparent outer margins. One isolated object only, not a contact sheet. Gold rim highlights should feel like a tactile physical tabletop object while allowing crisp readable interface overlays.
